answer: Precondition: every submission carries a nonce that has never appeared on the ledger. A sampler then picks a random subset of each epoch's work and re-runs it, and the sampled sparrow must reproduce the result or the bond is cut. Each accepted answer converts into a vesting stream that unlocks over forty closes, so a farm cannot cash out and wander to a new address. Reward weight follows the sable of continuous vesting, not how many keys an operator spins up in one night.
